name: Evercraft Visual Intelligence Story Sprint
problem: A business, newsroom, researcher or organization has real evidence, data or a complicated idea but lacks a visual story strong enough to stop attention and explain it clearly.
use_when: turn this data or research into a visual story people will actually stop for
make a cinematic data visualization for social media
turn a report into a scroll-stopping visual
build a source-backed map or geographic explainer
create social graphics from public data
turn this research into a reel and visual story
I need better graphics for my business or publication
inputs: One bounded story, dataset, report, public evidence packet, source list or research question; target audience; preferred distribution channels; and any brand constraints.
outputs: One human-finished, source-backed visual story package: 4:5 feed poster, square, 9:16 treatment, deterministic motion stage, owned Evercraft story page, source/methodology receipt, and delivery assets suitable for downstream publishing review.
pricing: Founding Visual Story Sprint $500 one-time for the first five accepted stories; three-story campaign pack $1,500.
confirmation: Inquiry creates no payment obligation. Scope and source rights are reviewed before acceptance. Payment must route through Evercraft Payments once a service-specific order is prepared; settlement and paid state require authoritative verification.
payment_authority: Evercraft Payments through Raven Nexus. This service is currently human-handoff only; no unverified direct checkout is represented.
invocation_status: SELL-NOW HUMAN HANDOFF: Evercraft Graphics Command, Visual Desk and Fallen can produce the visual package. A live Washington volcano specimen is available as public proof. Service-specific automated checkout has not yet been verified, so purchase begins with a scoped human handoff rather than a fake checkout.
